purpose: Read-only cost-risk and exit-path diagnosis of existing ETH V8 3m/5m trades; no OHLCV, signal, exit, or account replay.
frozen_rule: V6 raw + V7 prior_squeeze_run3 + signed rope distance <= 3 ATR; next-open entry; five-bar extreme plus 0.2 ATR; minimum 2 ATR risk; 2R activates 4 ATR trailing; raw V6 opposite exits; fixed 0.2% round-trip cost.

single_predeclared_gate.definition: fee_r = 0.002 / frozen initial_risk_frac; equivalent to initial risk fraction >=0.004
single_predeclared_gate.causal_limit: initial_risk_frac includes next-open filled entry and is only an entry-time check, not necessarily known at signal close

history_status: Previously authorized and already-studied historical/holdout-era ledger re-analysis. This builder reads no OHLCV and is not a new blind validation or new OHLCV exposure.
